review_scope.coverage: Full caller review retained from R1, plus exact R1-to-R2 diff and producer/helper Store and Guard accounting. Traced every caller Store construction and helper run Store construction; no monkeypatch or Store alias exists. The caller producer Store P and helper Store H have independent control_bytes counters and share only the original-clock/cancel/RSS Guard.
review_scope.accounting: P enforces SourceFiles bytes plus P.control_bytes <=3 MiB. H initializes its own Store and independently enforces H.control_bytes <=6 MiB. Therefore source+producer control plus helper control has the declared <=9 MiB cap; helper log-range reads have their separate <=160 KiB cap.
review_scope.execution: No import, compile, test, fixture, helper invocation, network, CI, or native action. Static source/data review only.
review_scope.qualification: NONE. Caller/helper runtime, owner workflow, hosted-runner compatibility, artifact upload, and private intake remain unverified.

historical_review_reconciliation.note: Its sole read-budget finding was a false positive, retracted in SOURCE_REVIEW_CORRECTION_R1.json. That frozen report and correction are preserved; they do not describe the current R2 verdict.

bounded_anchors.detail: Producer budget and producer Store construction.
Only child args and shared Guard go to module.run; producer Store remains local.
R2 reports combined control/source cap and separate log-range read cap.
Guard has deadline/cancel/RSS state only; helper Store creates independent control counter and enforces 6 MiB.

overall_limit: PASS applies only to this pinned caller source and stated source-review scope. It is not runtime, CI, workflow, intake, or product qualification.
